sourceRefs.locator: Section 2, pp. 77–81, Figs. 2–4: Naqada IIIA, c. 3200 BCE, incised tags, painted pots and seal impressions, proposed readings and their limits
Sections 1–3, pp. 103–107: Tomb U-j, c. 3320 BCE, bone and ivory labels and alternatives to interpretation of certain sign groups as rulers’ names

note.de: Die Zeichen tragenden Täfelchen sind in Grab U-j belegt. Das Fenster umfasst zwei publizierte ungefähre Datierungen des Grabkontexts, etwa 3320 und 3200 v. Chr. Mehrere Lesungen bleiben umstritten.
note.en: The marked tags are attested in Tomb U-j. The window spans two published approximate dates for the burial context, about 3320 and 3200 BCE. Several readings remain disputed.
